title: Pectolinarigenin alleviates calcium oxalate-induced renal inflammation and oxidative stress by binding to HIF-1alpha.
authors: Yao, Rui; Pan, Jia-Shan; He, Ruo-Bing; Hou, Bing-Bing; Suo, Xiao-Guo; Li, Guo-Xiang; Xia, Kai-Guo; Hu, De-Kai; Mao, Xi-Ke; Li, Wei; Hao, Zong-Yao
one_liner_zh: 该文研究天然代谢物pectolinarigenin结合HIF-1alpha缓解草酸钙肾钙质沉着症，核心为小分子-蛋白互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Calcium oxalate (CaOx) crystals are the main constituents of renal crystals in humans and induce tubular lumen damage in renal tubules, leading to renal calcium deposition and kidney stone formation. Oxidative stress and inflammation play important roles in regulating calcium oxalate-induced injury. Here, we evaluated the efficacy in inhibiting oxidation and inflammation of pectinolinarigenin, a biologically active natural metabolite, in CaOx nephrocalcinosis and further explored its targets of action. First, we developed cellular and mouse models of calcium oxalate renal nephrocalcinosis and identified the onset of oxidative stress and inflammation according to experimental data. We found that pectolinarigenin inhibited this onset while reducing renal crystal deposition. Network pharmacology was subsequently utilized to screen for hypoxia-inducible factor-1alpha (HIF-1alpha), a regulator involved in the body's release and over-oxidation of inflammatory factors. Finally, molecular docking, cellular thermal shift assay, and other experiments to detect HIF-1alpha expression showed that pectolinarigenin directly combined with HIF-1alpha and prevented downstream reactive oxygen species activation and release. Our results indicate that pectolinarigenin can target and inhibit HIF-1alpha-mediated inflammatory responses and oxidative stress damage and be a novel drug for CaOx nephrocalcinosis treatment.
abstract_zh: 草酸钙（CaOx）晶体是人类肾脏晶体的主要成分，可诱导肾小管腔内损伤，导致肾脏钙沉积和肾结石形成。氧化应激和炎症在调节草酸钙诱导的损伤中发挥重要作用。在此，我们评估了具有生物活性的天然代谢物pectolinarigenin在CaOx肾钙质沉着症中抑制氧化和炎症的功效，并进一步探讨了其作用靶点。首先，我们建立了草酸钙肾钙质沉着症的细胞和小鼠模型，并根据实验数据确定了氧化应激和炎症的发生。我们发现pectolinarigenin抑制了这种发生，同时减少了肾脏晶体沉积。随后，利用网络药理学筛选出缺氧诱导因子-1α（HIF-1α），这是一种参与机体炎症因子释放和过度氧化的调节因子。最后，通过分子对接、细胞热位移分析及其他实验检测HIF-1α表达，结果表明pectolinarigenin直接与HIF-1α结合，并阻止下游活性氧的激活和释放。我们的结果表明，pectolinarigenin可靶向抑制HIF-1α介导的炎症反应和氧化应激损伤，并可能成为治疗CaOx肾钙质沉着症的新型药物。
